items.headline: North Texas QB Tayven Jackson out with upper-body injury
items.description: North Texas senior quarterback Tayven Jackson, who is sixth in the FBS with 3,005 passing yards, will miss at least the next two games with an upper-body injury.

items.headline: Peterson's 4 TDs help UTSA beat North Texas 35-16 for share of American Conference lead
